contractorNotes: Prepared 5-stage milestone plan ("Estate Access Road & Reinforced Stormwater Drainage") at ₦100M - ₦200M. Ready for your review, price discussion, and contract sign-off.

proposedPlan.presetName: Estate Access Road & Reinforced Stormwater Drainage
proposedPlan.description: Civil works template for private estate road paving, reinforced stormwater culverts, stone base compaction, and solar streetlighting.

stages.title: Site Clearing, Topsoil Stripping & Sub-Grade Compaction
stages.evidence: Surveyor centerline GPS benchmarks, California Bearing Ratio (CBR) soil test, sub-grade nuclear density test

stages.title: Concrete Box Culverts & U-Drain Channels
stages.evidence: Drain invert levels check, culvert rebar spacing, precast drain cover load certificates

stages.title: Crushed Granite Stone Base & Prime Coat
stages.evidence: Stone aggregate grading sieve analysis, prime coat bitumen spray rate test, rolling pass compaction

stages.title: Heavy-Duty Interlocking Paving Stones / Asphalt Surfacing
stages.evidence: 80mm heavy-duty paver crushing strength (>=45 MPa), sand bed leveling, asphalt core temperature & thickness test

stages.title: Solar Streetlight Poles, Kerb Painting & Signage
stages.evidence: Galvanized pole footing depth, solar battery storage autonomy check, thermoplastic road marking reflectivity
